rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: ボート部門の最大のディーラー。Sea RayとBoston Whalerを独占的に販売
relations.text_en: Largest boat dealer; exclusive Sea Ray and Boston Whaler dealer in most of its markets

source.label: MarineMax 10-K(2025年9月期)
source.quote: We have agreements with Brunswick covering Sea Ray products and Boston Whaler products and are the exclusive dealer of Sea Ray and Boston Whaler boats in almost all of our geographic markets.

companies.name: ホワイトリバー・マリン・グループ

relations.text: エンジン・電子機器部門の主要顧客
relations.text_en: A key customer of its Propulsion and Navico segments

source.label: Brunswick 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: including White River Marine Group, LLC for the Propulsion and Navico Group segments and MarineMax, Inc. for the Boat segment.

relations.text: 共同出資・共同経営する会社

source.label: Brunswick 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We share ownership and management responsibilities with jointly owned companies such as BAC and Tohatsu Marine Corporation.

relations.text: Garminが10-Kで、船舶向け製品の主な競合として挙げる(Navico)
relations.text_en: Garmin names Brunswick's Navico among principal marine competitors

source.label: Garmin 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Garmin believes that its principal competitors are Furuno, Johnson Outdoors, Navico (Brunswick), and Raymarine (Teledyne).

companies.name: ジョンソン・アウトドアーズ

relations.text: Johnson Outdoorsが10-Kで、大手の競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: Johnson Outdoors names Brunswick among large competitors

source.label: Johnson Outdoors 10-K(2025年9月期)
source.quote: We compete with several large domestic and foreign companies such as Brunswick, Garmin, and Aqua Lung

companies.name: マスタークラフト・ボート

relations.text: MasterCraftが10-Kで、大手の競合の筆頭に挙げる
relations.text_en: MasterCraft lists Brunswick first among large competitors

source.label: MasterCraft 10-K(2026年6月期)
source.quote: we face competition from large national and regional manufacturers such as Brunswick Corporation, Malibu Boats, Inc.

relations.text: Expion360が10-Kで、Brunswick傘下Relionを競合に挙げる
relations.text_en: Expion360 names Brunswick-owned Relion as a competitor

source.label: Expion360 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Relion (which was acquired by Brunswick Corporation in September 2021)
